newsitem.title: USA: Florida Panthers to buy Boca Raton Resort.
newsitem.headline: Florida Panthers to buy Boca Raton Resort.

text.p: Florida Panthers Holdings Inc said Friday it has agreed to acquire the assets and liabilities of the Boca Raton Hotel & Club.

The transaction is valued at $325 million and will result in the issuance of about 4.9 million class A common shares, warrants to purchase about 980,000 additional shares and assumption of all liabilities.

The Boca Raton Resort & Club located in Boca Raton, Fla., has 963 rooms, including a separate beach club containing 214 guest rooms and golf, tennis, a full-service marina, water sports, state-of-the-art fitness centers and other facilities.

By year-end, it is scheduled to complete a $40 million expansion and renovation plan which it began in mid-1996; included in the plan are a new 130,000 square-foot conference facility, a new tennis and fitness center complex and certain other significant improvements.

Florida Panthers said "We have added a very profitable asset and a talented management team. We will continue to explore other opportunities in luxury resorts and club properties." ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
